items.description: Kitchen leak detection and moisture measurements
items.rationale: Water escaping from the copper supply is covered under §2.4.2, and §7.1.7(e)–(g) covers source location, moisture measurements, necessary labour and one call-out. Using Case 21, allow about €650 for 14 technician-hours, €450 for acoustic pinpointing, €165 for moisture measurements and €235 for the call-out.

items.description: Access, copper pipe repair and re-insulation
items.rationale: The localized indoor pipe failure is covered under §2.4.3(a), with necessary access and like-for-like reinstatement under §7.1.7. Allow about €140 to expose the run, €200 to replace just over 1.5 m of copper and its fittings, and €60 to remove and replace the soaked foam lagging.

Section 7.1.7(f) permits the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. The leak detector's call-out is on a separate contractor invoice, so allow €76 for the plumber's vehicle charge, in line with Case 21.

items.description: Drying of kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and completion readings for the documented wet floor and wall base. Allow about €100 for one condensation dryer for roughly seven days and €100 for setup, collection and final readings, with no separate electricity allowance under §7.1.8(d).
